summary: Global dataset-first selection chose PIIE. The pass preserves address-versus-headquarters semantics, adds a current Washington primary-office connection, ingests PIIE's August 3 Inu Manak personnel update, and queues explicit-HQ plus roster recovery.

sources.title: PIIE welcomes trade expert Inu Manak as new senior fellow

title: Hourly Auto-Dig:PIIE Washington location and Inu Manak update

data.research_question: What defensible public location connection can be added for the globally selected PIIE target, and what material current organizational news has changed PIIE since the July 31 roster baseline?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent successful hourly merges, open PRs/issues, live repository instructions, executable v0.9.0 schema, current PIIE manifest, and canonical organization through the GitHub connector. Applied reproducible dataset-first selection with hard recency, direct-conflict, and geography exclusions. Reviewed first-party PIIE contact and annual-report evidence plus the organization-managed LinkedIn location label without collapsing contact-address and headquarters semantics. Only after the location slice was resolved, searched current PIIE newsroom and staff surfaces from the July 31 roster baseline through August 19 and ingested the material Inu Manak personnel update.
classification_rules: Dataset/topic selection is approximately uniform after recency/conflict weighting and is not weighted by row count.
The previous three successful hourly datasets are hard exclusions when alternatives exist.
Directly overlapping active PR slices are excluded when a non-conflicting alternative exists.
The dominant geographies of the previous three successful hourly runs are avoided when alternatives exist.
A first-party contact or annual-report address is not promoted to headquarters without explicit headquarters wording; organization-managed secondary headquarters labels remain separately attributed.
No coordinates are created without defensible geocoding or authoritative coordinate evidence.
Current news is ingested only when it adds a material event, correction, relationship, location change, or counterevidence.

findings.selection_algorithm: Sort the complete 54-entry dataset/topic universe; remove the previous-three successful hourly datasets and direct-conflict dataset/topic slices; select eligible_pool[seed mod 38]. For the selected PIIE source dataset, sort its actionable canonical target pool and select target_pool[target_seed mod 1]. Dataset size does not affect dataset-stage probability.

findings.result: PIIE's first-party contact page and 2024 annual report publish 1750 Massachusetts Avenue NW, Washington, DC as the Institute address. The organization-managed LinkedIn page labels Washington, DC as headquarters and the same address as its primary location. The pass therefore models a first-party primary-office relation and keeps the LinkedIn headquarters label as a separate reported_headquarters_at relation. No coordinates were added.

After completing the location slice, current PIIE news and official staff surfaces were searched with overlap from the 2026-07-31 roster baseline through 2026-08-19. The material organizational update found was PIIE's 2026-08-03 announcement that trade expert Inu Manak joined as a senior fellow; this is ingested as a person, personnel event, and role relation. Other fresh results reviewed were research/commentary rather than material PIIE organizational-state changes.
